newsitem.title: USA: NFL-CHARGERS RE-SIGN DEFENSIVE TACKLE DAVIS TO FOUR-YEAR DEAL.
newsitem.headline: NFL-CHARGERS RE-SIGN DEFENSIVE TACKLE DAVIS TO FOUR-YEAR DEAL.

text.p: Unrestricted free agent defensive tackle Reuben Davis decided to remain with the San Diego Chargers, agreeing to a new four-year contract on Tuesday.
The 31-year-old Davis recorded 30 tackles, three sacks, one fumble recovery and two pass deflections in 15 games last season, his third with the Chargers.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Davis has started 47 of the last 48 regular-season games for the Chargers since signing as a free agent prior to the 1994 campaign.

Davis was a ninth-round pick by Tampa Bay in 1988 and played four-plus seasons with the Buccaneers before being dealt to Phoenix in October 1992. In nine seasons, he has compiled 401 tackles and 20 1/2 sacks.
